test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: O is the center of a circle and A is a point on a major arc BC of the circle. ∠BOC and ∠BAC are the angles made by the minor BC on the center and circumference, respectively. If ∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°, then find ∠BOC.
solution:
**Given**

∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°

**Concept used**

The angle subtended by the arc on the centre of the circle is twice that of the angle subtended by the same arc on some point on the circumference.

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243e0747e4e6f36ce68c36bb2f7919851cbdac845e304cfbffb2aa72e333f14c.png] 

∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°

∠ABO = ∠OAB = 40° (opposite angles of the equal sides are equal)

∠ACO = ∠OAC = 30° (opposite angles of the equal sides are equal)

∠BAC = 40 + 30 = 70°

∠BOC = 2 × 70 = 140°

**The answer is 140°.**
